title: Readiness checkmatrix & sprint cadence - product ops
content:
One-page working sheet for sprint-level readiness, meant to be copied into sprint notes and update trackers. Informal: contains TODOs, open questions, and a lightweight signal matrix for go/no-go.

SUMMARY:
- Purpose: provide a compact, actionable readiness matrix that ties roadmap milestones to explicit KPIs, owners, and a rapid go/no-go checklist for each release sprint.
- Scope: applies to GA or major feature rollouts managed by product-ops and product-hosted-api. Not a replacement for full launch playbook, but a fast operational view for weekly status meetings.

OBJECTIVES:
1) Make the launch signal set explicit and measurable (3–7 signals).
2) Surface blockers early with owner and ETA.
3) Keep product, eng, SRE, and CS aligned on deploy windows.

SPRINT CADENCE & MEETING RHYTHM:
- Sprint length: 2 weeks (standard).
- Weekly readiness sync: Thursdays 10:00 PT (30m) — attendees: product-ops, PM, engineering lead, SRE on call, CS lead.
- Pre-launch dry run: 2 business days before deploy (checklights run).

READINESS CHECKMATRIX (one row per major milestone)
Columns: milestone | target date | owner | signal (pass/fail) | current | blocker | mitigation | go/no-go suggestion

Row example entries (copy into tracker):
- Feature: hosted streaming latency improvements | 2026-03-15 | Owner: Miguel Ortega (eng-serving-runtime) | Signal: median p95 latency <= 180ms under synthetic load | Current: p95 = 210ms (staging) | Blocker: kernel rollout causing jitter on 8xA100 | Mitigation: roll back kernel change + enable conservative batch limits | Go/no-go: soft-no until p95 <= 190ms or staging smoke green

- Feature: model catalog rollout v2 (UI + routing policy) | 2026-03-22 | Owner: Lina Wang (product-hosted-api) | Signal: 95% of routing rules validated in canary; no regressions in route logs | Current: 88% validated, 2 routing errors in canary | Blocker: missing fallback mapping for private deployments | Mitigation: patch mapping + canary replay | Go/no-go: conditional yes with migration window

KPI TRACKER (snapshot) — keep O(4) metrics per feature
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 (ms) — source: telemetry/console route-level
- Error rate: 5xx rate (%) per 1k requests — target < 0.2% for GA
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) — target: within budget band set by finance
- Quality regression: eval pass-rate on golden prompts — target >= 97%

Quick KPI snapshot (date: 2026-02-28):
- Hosted streaming latency (prod routes): p95 = 175ms, error rate = 0.14%, cost/1k tokens = $1.08
- Model catalog canary: eval pass = 95.5% (golden set), logging spikes in region eu-west-1 observed

GO / NO-GO SIGNALS (recommendation ranking):
- Critical (must pass): end-to-end smoke tests green; error rate < target; security review signed off; migrations applied and reversible.
- Important (prefer pass): performance SLOs within 15% of target; rollout docs updated; CS playbook available.
- Nice to have: demo ops-runbook, whitepaper blurb, comms draft.

GO/NO-GO CHECKLIST (binary checklist for final decision):
- [ ] Smoke tests: all green in staging (owner: eng-release)
- [ ] Canary traffic >= 5% for 48h without regression (owner: platform-engineering)
- [ ] SLO dashboard shows latency & error OK for 24h (owner: observability)
- [ ] Security sign-off complete (owner: security-and-compliance)
- [ ] Backout plan validated and rehearsed (owner: site-reliability-engineering)
- [ ] CS runbook + KB article ready (owner: customer-success)
- [ ] Release notes & dev docs drafted (owner: developer-experience)
- [ ] Legal/regulatory checklist (if applicable) signed (owner: finance-and-legal)

RISK MATRIX (quick bullets):
- Risk: Kernel/runtime regression -> Impact: p95 spikes -> Prob: medium -> Mitigation: conservative rollout + auto-fallback to previous incarnation
- Risk: Cost overrun due to unexpected token volume -> Impact: budget exceed -> Prob: low -> Mitigation: enable temporary rate-limits and cost alerts; inform finance
- Risk: Model quality regression on minority language -> Impact: user-facing poor outputs -> Prob: medium -> Mitigation: gated rollout by region/language + sampling-based evals

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS (working items):
- Who owns the final comms approval for Dedicated customers (legal + account mgmt)? => action: Evan to confirm by 2026-03-03.
- Do we want to require 48h canary for all GA releases or allow exceptions? Draft proposal: default 48h, exceptions by CTO + product sign-off.
- Add a telemetry dashboard tab that shows "readiness signals" at-a-glance (product-ops + observability). Feasibility: SRE to scope (Evan).

DECISION LOG (short):
- 2026-02-20: Decided canary threshold for model catalog reduced from 10% to 5% to reduce user impact during validation (owner: Lina).

NEXT STEPS (this sprint):
- Product: finalize canary fallback mapping (Lina) — ETA 2026-03-02.
- Eng: stabilize kernel rollout or pin previous kernel on 8xA100 fleet (Miguel) — ETA 2026-03-04.
- Observability: add read-only readiness dashboard tab and a synthetic job for p95 latency (Evan) — ETA 2026-03-05.
- CS: draft customer-facing KB and support playbook for rollback scenarios (Sofia) — ETA 2026-03-07.

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep this doc lightweight and copy a snapshot into the sprint notes each Thursday. If decision flips from go to no-go, note exact signal that caused block and next step.

---
Version history:
- 2025-11-03: Initial draft (Priya).
- 2026-02-20: Added canary threshold decision and kernel blocker entry.
- 2026-02-28: KPI snapshot update and added open questions for comms owner.

END OF WORKING SHEET.
